scripts/check_tests_actually_run.py. This is a RATCHET, not an amnesty: the
listed tests are known debt with a tracking issue, and the gate fails if a
NEW one appears, if a listed test disappears, or if a listed test starts
running (at which point the exemption must go so it is gated for real).
